title: L0-009 Observation Schema
description: Data validation schema for L0-009 Gold Lease Rates / Forward Rates. Production variable: 3-month CME-derived Gold Implied Lease Rate proxy (GILR-CME). This is a derived proxy, not a directly observed OTC lease rate.

observation_date.description: Date of CME settlement used. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Trading days only.

gilr_cme_pct_pa.description: 3-month CME-derived GILR proxy in % p.a. = SOFR3M minus CME implied forward rate. Can be negative (backwardation). Production series.

sofr_3m_pct_pa.description: 3-month term SOFR in % p.a. from FRED SOFR3M. Input to GILR computation.

sofr_vintage_date.description: Date of SOFR3M observation used. Must be <= observation_date.

sofr_source.description: FRED_SOFR_COMPOUNDED if overnight SOFR compounded substitute was used.

cme_implied_forward_rate_pct_pa.description: Implied 3M forward rate derived from CME settlement spread in % p.a. = ((far/front) - 1) * (360/days) * 100.

cme_front_contract.description: COMEX gold futures front contract code (e.g. GCQ26).

cme_front_settlement.description: Settlement price of front contract in USD/troy oz.

cme_front_expiry.description: Actual expiry date of front contract. ISO 8601.

cme_far_contract.description: COMEX gold futures far contract code (e.g. GCZ26).

cme_far_settlement.description: Settlement price of far contract in USD/troy oz.

cme_far_expiry.description: Actual expiry date of far contract. ISO 8601. Must be > cme_front_expiry.

days_between_contracts.description: Actual calendar days between front and far expiry dates.

cme_source.description: CME_MANUAL if operator downloaded settlement file manually.

ingested_at.description: UTC timestamp of parser run. ISO 8601.

is_revised.description: True when this record replaces a previously stored observation for the same observation_date with a changed gilr_cme_pct_pa value.

prior_gilr_cme_pct_pa.description: Previously stored gilr_cme_pct_pa for this observation_date. Required (non-null) when is_revised=true.

revision_reason.description: Explanation of why the value changed. Required (non-null) when is_revised=true.

anomaly_notes.description: Required when validation_status is FLAG or FAIL.

examples._fixture_note: Static development fixture. Normal contango environment. Values are illustrative.
Static development fixture. Negative GILR (backwardation) — valid stress-period signal; always FLAG not FAIL.
examples.anomaly_notes: Negative GILR-CME (-0.34% p.a.) indicates backwardation or tight physical financing conditions; economically valid. days_between_contracts=59 below minimum 60; contract pair at boundary.
